notes.note: Parker didn't have a big day  with 20 touches this week in what was a high scoring game. This is now five under 100 in a row.
Parker was solid with 26 disposals but another week now without hitting triple figures. He did have a hit to the shoulder early but was ok and continued.
Parker had 27 touches as he tried to recover from two under 100 but he wasn't able to as his efficiency was down at 51%.
Parker bounced back last week and even though he didn't crack triple figures it was still the third highest score for the Roos from his 25 disposals.

Parker had a quieter day with his equal lowest score of the season so far. He had 21 touches but just 1 mark and 1 tackle. He should bounce back and he will be looked at by those needing a Holmes replacement.
Parker continues his good run of scoring off that backline with his 10 marks to go with 26 disposals.
Parker had 27 disposals and all of them were effective. This is now three over 120 in a row for him.
Parker was popular with coaches and he didn't disappoint with 31 disposals at 93% efficiency. This makes it back to back 120+ scores.
30 disposals and 11 marks for Parker. This makes it two over 100 now in the past three as he looks to be regaining the form we saw in the early season.
Not the day Parker owners wanted with his 22 disposals coming with just a 68% efficiency.
20 touches for Parker and fourth under 100 in a row with this the lowest in the last three.
Parker top scored for the Roos with his 28 disposals also being the equal highest in the game. It was an awful day for the Roos but it was his best score in the last three.
10 marks for Parker and 24 of his 29 disposals were by foot. A great bounce back form last week's poor score.
Parker bounced back to the form of round 1 with a. massive score from 33 disposals and 13 marks. But remember he won't play Essendon ever week.
Parker was the star for the Roos and spent time down back but did move to the mids at times.
